_README: The ONE file Cameron edits to turn on ElevenLabs. Fill api_key and the five voices with ids from your ElevenLabs library, then run: python3 revoice_sweep.py --range 1-10. Until api_key and a speaker's voice are set, that speaker falls back to edge-tts and nothing breaks. Never use a Multilingual model_id (Voice Law). Do NOT commit a real api_key to git — prefer the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var; this file's api_key is a convenience only.

voices.jesus: PUT_VOICE_ID  (AMERICAN male, warm, low — Voice Law: never British/Multilingual)
voices.god: PUT_VOICE_ID  (the Father / premortal Christ — deep, weighty)
voices.scripture: PUT_VOICE_ID  (other KJV speakers: prophets, apostles, people)

_lexicon_README: Archaic KJV words ElevenLabs may mispronounce. grapheme + phoneme(IPA) is best; grapheme + alias (plain respelling ElevenLabs reads aloud) also works. Seeded from Cameron's past complaints. Homographs that depend on context (tear=tare #51, bow #119, records #62) are intentionally NOT here — a global rule would break every other 'tear'/'bow'/'records'; those get handled by the model + per-line review. Created once as an ElevenLabs pronunciation dictionary and cached in _lexicon_locator.
